jobs.job_description:
Youre building systems that power AI workflows - REST APIs that handle concurrent requests, databases that dont lose data, deployments that dont wake you up at 3 AM. You understand that backend isnt just about making things work; its about making them work reliably.

You wont be writing microservices in a vacuum. Your APIs feed mobile apps, web interfaces, and integrations. Your database decisions matter. Your deployments get reviewed. Your code runs in production, and youre the one who fixes it when it breaks.

Frontend work exists, but youre being hired because the backend is the constraint. Frontend will evolve. The API is permanent.

What You Will Do
Design and build REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
Write efficient SQL queries, optimise indexes, and manage relational databases under load.
Implement secure authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
Deploy backend services using Docker and containerised workflows.
Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
Debug production issues and ship fixes with minimal ceremony.
Collaborate closely with frontend teams on API contracts and data flow.
Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews.
Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
What We Are Looking For
1+ years of production experience with Python and Django - non-negotiable.
Demonstrable experience building and shipping REST APIs with Django REST Framework.
Strong SQL fundamentals: write efficient queries, understand indexes, optimise slow queries.
Direct experience deploying production code and debugging issues in production.
Git workflow and ability to write clean, reviewable code.
Understanding of authentication, authorisation, and basic security patterns.
Good to Have
PostgreSQL experience (we use Postgres, not MySQL).
Docker containerisation for local development or deployment.
Basic AWS knowledge (EC2, RDS, or similar).
Experience with relational database design and migrations.
Familiarity with asynchronous task queues (Celery or similar).
Previous work on multi-user or multi-tenant systems.
Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors, webhooks, integrations).
Redis or caching layer optimisation.
GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline experience.
Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
What You Will Work On
Python (3.8+) with Django and Django REST Framework.
PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and task queues.
React.js on the frontend - you own the API contract, not the UI.
AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, RDS.
Docker for containerised deployments, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
Celery for background job processing.
Why Kuvaka
Your code runs in production, not in staging. The APIs you build power healthcare applications, manufacturing workflows, and enterprise platforms - real users, real uptime requirements, real stakes.
You work with senior engineers who care about architecture and code quality. You get exposure to AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and working across multiple verticals in one role.
Growth is tied to shipping, not time served.

Job Summary

The Engineer - Data Analytics and Applications role is responsible for developing and supporting secure software applications, data workflows, and analytics.

This role will initially assist with API and UI development of existing tools.

Over time, the role will expand into dashboarding, ETL/data engineering, and data science/ML/AI enablement to turn connected product and operational data into actionable insights.

This position reports to the Pall Computational Team Manager and is part of the R&D department. This role will be located in Pune, India and will be an on-site role, coordinating primarily with teams in the US and some groups in Europe and Japan.

Support the development, testing, and improvement of secure IoT software applications, including API, UI, backend, and workflow functionality.
Help prepare connected product software for penetration testing by supporting issue resolution, security documentation, validation, and application readiness activities.
Develop dashboards, reports, and analytics workflows that turn connected product, operational, and engineering data into actionable insights.
Build and support data workflows that improve access to structured and unstructured data across applications, analytics, and reporting use cases.
Enable future data science, machine learning, and AI capabilities by preparing datasets, supporting model development and integration, and helping teams apply advanced analytics to real-world business and engineering problems.
Inherit, understand, and improve a legacy codebase by supporting ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, refactoring, documentation, and modernization efforts while ensuring continuity of existing application functionality.
Requirements

The essential requirements of the job include:

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience developing or supporting software applications, APIs, user interfaces, data workflows, or analytics tools.
Proficiency with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
Familiarity with SQL, data visualization, and application environments hosted or deployed on AWS.
Strong communication skills, with fluency in English.
Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

N/A

Connected product, IoT, or secure cloud-based software applications.
Developing dashboards, reports, analytics workflows, or data visualization solutions.
Data science, machine learning, AI, or generative AI enablement, including dataset preparation, model integration, or applied analytics.
ETL, data engineering, or data preparation workflows involving structured, unstructured, connected product, operational, or engineering data.

Job Overview

Role Summary

The System Integration Test Engineer is responsible for executing system integration testing (SIT) across applications, devices, APIs, and data systems to ensure overall product quality and reliability. This role focuses on validating end-to-end workflows, performing functional and performance testing, and leveraging modern tools, automation, AI techniques, and database validation to support high-quality releases.

A Day In The Life

Key Responsibilities

System Integration Testing

Execute end-to-end SIT scenarios across multiple systems, including APIs, backend services, and user interfaces
Validate data flow, integration points, and system interactions
Identify, log, and track defects, integration issues, and inconsistencies
Support test planning, test case creation, and test execution

Automation & Modern Testing Tools

Develop and execute automation scripts for regression and integration testing
Work with tools such as:
Selenium / Cypress (UI testing)
Postman / REST Assured (API testing)
Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines

Performance & Load Testing (Basic)

Assist in executing load and performance tests using tools such as:
JMeter / k6
Analyze test results and identify basic performance bottlenecks

AI-Assisted Testing (Emerging Skills)

Use AI-powered testing tools for:
Test case generation
Defect prediction
Analysis of test results
Support implementation of intelligent automation practices

Database & Data Validation

Validate data integrity across systems using:
SQL queries
Data comparison techniques
Work with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL)
Verify ETL/data pipeline accuracy and consistency

Defect Management & Troubleshooting

Log and manage defects using tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps
Perform basic root cause analysis with guidance from senior engineers
Collaborate with development teams to resolve issues

Collaboration & Agile Participation

Work in Agile/Scrum teams, participating in:
Sprint planning
Daily stand-ups
Retrospectives
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams
What will help you thrive in this role

Required Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
2+ years of experience in:
Software testing / QA
System Integration Testing (preferred)

Technical Skills

Testing Tools

API Testing: Postman, REST Assured
UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress
Test Management: JIRA, Azure DevOps

Performance Testing (Basic)

JMeter, k6 (preferred)

Programming / Scripting

Basic knowledge of:
Python / Java / JavaScript

Database Skills

Strong SQL fundamentals
Experience querying and validating data
